_meta.title: v44 validation targets — formal, cell-type-separated, provenance-tracked
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for what the model is fit to. Each target tagged with cell_type (P7_GNP | MB | MB_vs_GNP), provenance (precise figure), current model_actual, and pass/fail. Prevents the MB/GNP conflation and the provenance drift that a 3-source cross-audit (harness vs compendium vs DATA_PROVENANCE) surfaced on 2026-07-25.

companion_docs.compendium: docs/Ezh2_CcnD1_model_targets.md — raw manuscript experimental values (Chahin et al.), organized by data type
companion_docs.cdk46i_research: docs/cdk46i_resistance_research.md — the palbociclib reversibility / residual-cycling literature

legend.cell_type: P7_GNP = postnatal-d7 cerebellar granule-neuron progenitor; MB = SHH-medulloblastoma (culture); MB_vs_GNP = cross-type ratio
legend.kind: level | fold | fraction | duration | binary | distribution
legend.source_type: manuscript_fig = Chahin et al. figure (primary lab data); external_lit = published external citation; unpublished = JP lab data not pinned to a figure; model_prediction = model output presented as a prediction; assumption = modeling choice
legend.tolerance: relative band on |actual-target|/target used by validate_v44 check()
legend.status: active = scored in validate_v44 (the 28/29); harness_mismatch = the harness check is a coarse/incorrect proxy for the true target; documented_nonformal = real data, deliberately not scored
legend.model_actual: current default-model value from validate_v44 run 2026-07-25 (28/29; lone miss = MB HU G2 fold)

OPEN_ISSUES: PERIOD — the sources AGREE on ~16h; there is NO conflict. Nakashima 2015 (live-imaging, mean 15.9h) + Contestabile 2013 (phase-resolved 16.25h). The '~22-23h' attributed to Nakashima in docs/Ezh2_CcnD1_model_targets.md §G and docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md §2.8 is a MISCITATION (and may propagate to the manuscript — check). The model's 22.8h is ~40% too slow vs BOTH sources; 22h is purely the growth default (mu=0.0005), literature-unsupported. Adopting the ~16h target FAILS the current model -> deferred to the coordinated CKI-split recalibration (GNP-16/MB-22), which needs the MB Tc JP is looking up. Correct the two old docs (and manuscript).
MB cell-cycle length: NO formal target. JP investigating (MB longer than GNP: higher CKI + transient G0s). k_mu_cki is the mechanism.

CyclinD1 MB+HHi/MB: harness + DATA_PROVENANCE use 0.144 (86% drop, load-bearing for the vismo-arrest/EZH2i-rescue logic); compendium §A lists 0.40 (60% drop). RECONCILE which is the true experimental fold.

EZH2i CyclinD1 fold: target 2.2 (Tazemetostat qPCR Fig 3C) + a separate genetic cKO 2.46x (RNA-seq Fig 3A). Model gives ~1.6 = genuine SHORTFALL (JP confirmed). The genetic 2.46x argues this is a real miss, NOT merely an old instant-derepression artifact.

ezh2_palbo_drop CELL-TYPE mismatch: the 0.444x EZH2-mRNA drop is measured in MB (Fig 4F qPCR), but the harness scores it on the GNP condition (GNP+CDK4/6i / GNP+SHH). Decide whether to move the check to MB.

CDK4/6i (palbociclib) is NOT a clean arrest: JP culture data = pRb+ cycling drops to 16-18% (residual), REVERSIBLE (washout 72h -> ~50%). Harness binary div==0 is a coarse single-lineage proxy; reversibility is unscored; the '+EZH2i no rescue' is a MODEL PREDICTION (Fig S9I,J), not a measurement.

MB phase-fraction data modality = experimental cell-culture MICROSCOPY (JP 2026-07-25), NOT flow cytometry — the two existing docs mislabel it 'flow'. The count-fraction analysis (age-weighting, G0/G1 unresolvable) still holds.

Distribution CVs are proposed; the measured per-phase SDs (compendium §F1/F2) are available to anchor them but not yet recorded as targets. Carry the SE-vs-SD caveat (compendium note #1: the 'SE' column is SD).

targets.notes: Key experimental rescue result; the RESCUABLE contrast to the CDK4/6i non-rescue prediction. Scored qualitatively (binary MB cycles + Fig 5C population figure), not as a fraction check.

distribution_features.name: GNP cycle-duration distribution
distribution_features.quantity: cell-cycle length: mean/SD/CV + sibling-vs-nonsibling variance decomposition
distribution_features.source: Nakashima 2015 (live-imaging lineage tracking; Fig 4A histogram spans ~6-40h). sigma from E|T1-T2|=1.128*sigma.
distribution_features.notes: Cycle length is LINEAGE-CORRELATED: siblings (sigma 1.94h, CV 0.12) far more alike than random pairs (sigma 5.11h, CV 0.32) => most variance is heritable/between-lineage, not within-lineage stochastic. Window truncation moves variance a lot (11.9->26.1 h2) but the mean barely (fan-out symmetric about a stable center). CAVEATS: (1) the unlabelled +/- on the means is SD, not SEM (SEM at n=143 would imply SD~44h, contradicted by the 6-40h histogram) — flag as inference if citing variance; (2) the non-sibling +/-1.72h is NOT a comparable dispersion (likely field-to-field spread) — use the 5.76h mean, ignore the +/-. Candidate ground-truth for the population-of-models cycle-duration CV.

non_formal_features.quantity: CyclinD1 fold, genetic cKO vs WT

non_formal_features.name: EZH2 GNP+HHi reduction
non_formal_features.quantity: EZH2 transcript drop under Hh block
non_formal_features.recommendation: soft documented feature (wide band); direct evidence EZH2 is Hh/mitogen-responsive; the GNP+HHi condition already runs -> candidate active check

non_formal_features.name: Palbo CyclinD1-up / E2f1-down (MB)
non_formal_features.quantity: CyclinD1 1.57x UP, E2f1 0.433x DOWN under palbociclib
non_formal_features.recommendation: E2f1 co-drop checks E2f-gating; CyclinD1-up is orthogonal de-repression (EZH2 falls -> CyclinD1 rises); candidate checks (Fig 4F kept only EZH2 so far)

non_formal_features.name: GNP+Tazemetostat phase folds
non_formal_features.recommendation: EZH2i proliferation-PROMOTION phenotype (complement to transcript de-repression); model runs GNP+EZH2i -> cheap candidate target

non_formal_features.name: Ezh2-OE MB phase folds
non_formal_features.recommendation: EZH2 gain-of-function -> G0 accumulation (largest directional flow in the paper); the only UP-direction test of the EZH2->arrest axis; currently untested

non_formal_features.name: Palbo MB phase folds
non_formal_features.recommendation: strongest phase signals in the dataset; S-fold + G0-fold far more discriminating than the binary arrest -> candidate partial checks constraining R-point block strength

non_formal_features.name: RO3306 (CDK1i) arrest
non_formal_features.recommendation: only condition arresting DOWNSTREAM of the R-point -> uniquely tests the mitotic-switch layer independent of CyclinD1; add as condition or documented feature

non_formal_features.name: Qualitative directional readouts
non_formal_features.quantity: rShh dose -> EZH2 up (Fig 4H); E2f1-OE -> EZH2 up (Fig 4D); Ezh2-OE -> CyclinD1 down (Fig 3E)
non_formal_features.recommendation: non-scored but load-bearing: ground the mitogen-dose term, E2f-gating, and repression direction respectively
